planets.name: WASP-123 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-123 with a 2.98-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: WASP-123 b was found in 2016 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-123. Its orbit and size follow Alexoudi 2022's fit, the archive's default.
